r.name: Two Counties Way
r.description: A long distance walk of 56 miles (90km) from Taunton to Starcross on the Exe estuary.

r.name: Killerton to Clyston Mill
r.description: Devonshire Countryside, Sparrow Park, Estate Farms, Clyston Mill, River Clyst

r.name: EuroVelo 1 - Atlantic Coast Route - part United Kingdom 2
r.name:fr: EuroVelo 1 - Route du littoral Atlantique - tronçon Royaume-Uni 2

r.name: Danes Wood Walk, Killerton
r.description: This enchanting circular starts at Killerton House & winds through the estate to Danes Wood before looping back. A great trail for spotting wildlife; the woodlands are home to songbirds & butterflies. Moderate slopes, uneven terrain & steps from car park.

r.name: Front Park and The Clump Walk, Killerton
r.description: Enjoy this circular across Front Park & up Dolbury Hill, known locally as The Clump. An extinct volcano, it's said to be home to a friendly dragon. At the top, find an Iron Age hillfort & views across the Exe Valley. Some steep inclines & uneven terrain.

r.name: Acland Walk, Killerton
r.description: At just over a mile the Acland circular walk is a buggy-friendly walk following surfaced paths through the parkland, garden and chapel grounds. Suitable for little legs, pushchairs, ordinary shoes and anyone who'd like to take a gentle stroll.

r.name: Ancient Trees Walk, Killerton
r.description: This circular walk highlights some of the many ancient trees that you can see in the garden and park at Killerton. Examples include gnarled sweet chestnuts that were planted some 250 years ago but as you follow the route, look around you to see many more.

r.name: Plains Walk, Killerton
r.description: This 2-mile dog-friendly walk reveals much of Killerton's wider parkland. The Plains feature veteran trees, open spaces, wildlife and breathtaking views. Seasonally muddy.

r.name: Killerton Dog Walk, Killerton
r.description: This is a circular walk with wide open space for dogs to be exercised on & off lead, with far-reaching views & rolling Devon countryside. There are signs on gates for where dogs can come off the lead. Woodland paths that can get muddy in places.

r.name: Killerton to Sprydon
r.description: A delightful walk through orchards and woodland, passing Holly Lodge and other picturesque thatched cottages at Sprydon. Circular walk following footpaths, tracks and quiet roads, with one main road crossing.

r.name: Deodar Glen Walk, Killerton
r.description: Discover Park Wood, Deodar Glen & The Plains before finishing with a close-up view of the old quarry & extinct volcano. The picturesque views at Killerton are brought to life on this dog-friendly walk. Grassy paths through parkland are muddy when wet.
